nodes.label: Dependabot Configuration (pip/npm/docker/github-actions weekly updates)
nodes.rationale: Two separate docker ecosystem entries (/backend, /frontend) because Dependabot does not scan Dockerfiles recursively from a single directory.

nodes.label: CI job: backend-tests (pytest unit tests, no DB)
nodes.rationale: Pure unit tests using fake repositories; no Postgres/.env needed since settings() only fails fast when DEBUG=false, and the default is true when env vars are unset.
nodes.norm_label: ci job: backend-tests (pytest unit tests, no db)

nodes.label: CI job: backend-lint (ruff check)
nodes.rationale: Only ruff check is run, not ruff format — formatting (Black-style) is deliberately not enforced here.

nodes.label: CI job: backend-integration-tests (real Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Spins up real Postgres to verify EXCLUDE USING gist double-booking guard, partial unique indexes for soft-deleted rows, and full HTTP-stack happy paths that fake-repository unit tests cannot exercise.

nodes.label: CI job: frontend-build (npm run build + npm audit)
nodes.norm_label: ci job: frontend-build (npm run build + npm audit)

nodes.label: CI job: frontend-e2e (Playwright against real backend+Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Catches things unit/integration tests cannot: real HTTP redirects and races between router guards and async store updates — found and fixed two real bugs this way (SetupWizard missing auth.ready, DashboardLayout/AppHeader not awaiting auth.logout() before redirect).
nodes.norm_label: ci job: frontend-e2e (playwright against real backend+postgres)

nodes.label: CI job: frontend-lint (eslint only)
nodes.rationale: Only eslint runs, not prettier --check — full autoformatting deliberately not forced.

nodes.label: CI job: compose-validate (docker compose config syntax check)
nodes.rationale: Uses dummy SECRET_KEY/SETUP_TOKEN values only to validate docker-compose.yml syntax/interpolation, not for a real run.
nodes.norm_label: ci job: compose-validate (docker compose config syntax check)

nodes.label: pip-audit exception: PYSEC-2026-1325 (ecdsa)
nodes.rationale: Only known vulnerability with no upstream fix; not exploitable because ecdsa is a transitive dependency of python-jose used only for RSA/EC algorithms, while this app signs JWTs exclusively with HS256 (symmetric HMAC).

nodes.label: npm audit continue-on-error exception (esbuild/vite dev-server findings)
nodes.rationale: Current high/moderate findings (path traversal etc. in vite's dev server) only affect `npm run dev`, not the deployed static build. Proper fix is a major vite 5→8 upgrade, deliberately deferred; step kept visible (not removed) to catch new findings on top of the known ones.
nodes.norm_label: npm audit continue-on-error exception (esbuild/vite dev-server findings)

nodes.label: Double-booking protection (repo check + EXCLUDE USING gist)
nodes.rationale: Two layers: a repository-level pre-insert check (readable error message) plus a DB-level `EXCLUDE USING gist` constraint with predicate `WHERE (status <> 'cancelled')` for race protection. The first migration (alembic/versions/0001_initial.py) creates the btree_gist extension and writes the constraint via raw SQL because SQLAlchemy's declarative API cannot express it.
nodes.norm_label: double-booking protection (repo check + exclude using gist)

nodes.label: Soft delete (deleted_at) with partial unique indexes
nodes.rationale: Applied to users, masters, services. Email/phone uniqueness enforced via partial unique indexes (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) rather than unique=True on the column, so soft-deleted rows free up the email/phone for reuse.
nodes.norm_label: soft delete (deleted_at) with partial unique indexes

nodes.label: Appointment state machine (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS)
nodes.rationale: pending → {confirmed, cancelled}; confirmed → {done, cancelled}; done/cancelled are terminal. Defined in appointment_service.py.

nodes.label: Layered architecture: routes → services → repositories → models
nodes.rationale: Repositories are the sole location containing SQL queries.
nodes.norm_label: layered architecture: routes → services → repositories → models

nodes.label: Inline WYSIWYG homepage editor (Admin → Settings)
nodes.rationale: Homepage rendering factored into reusable components (AppHeader.vue, HomePreview.vue, AppFooter.vue) with optional editable/content props (default false / from store, so the public site is unaffected). When editable, text nodes render via EditableText.vue and navigational links via EditableLink.vue (a non-navigating span instead of router-link/<a>, so clicking an editable brand/hero button doesn't leave the page). Both mutate the same reactive form object and save via PATCH /api/settings; fields with no direct visual representation (business hours, SEO) are edited in a separate 'More settings' modal.

nodes.label: JWT revocation via token_version counter
nodes.rationale: Each user has a token_version counter embedded in the token payload (ver) at issuance; get_current_user compares it against the current DB value on every request. Logout, password change/reset, and blocking increment the counter, instantly invalidating all previously issued (including compromised) tokens without a denylist or server-side sessions.

nodes.label: Access token in httpOnly cookie (SameSite=Lax, COOKIE_SECURE)
nodes.rationale: JS cannot read the cookie, closing the classic XSS token-theft vector. SameSite=Lax is sufficient CSRF protection for non-GET requests since the app is a pure JSON API with no form-encoded endpoints exploitable by a standard CSRF form. Secure flag is gated by COOKIE_SECURE (not DEBUG) — only when a real TLS terminator sits in front. Token is also returned in the response body of /auth/login, /auth/register, /api/setup for Swagger 'Authorize' and external API clients without cookie access; get_current_user accepts both sources.
nodes.norm_label: access token in httponly cookie (samesite=lax, cookie_secure)

nodes.label: VK ID login (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE)
nodes.rationale: First login creates an account or links to an existing one by matching email. Requires VK_CLIENT_ID; without it the 'Login via VK' button auto-hides via GET /api/auth/vk/enabled. Production requires a real HTTPS domain (VK ID disallows IP/localhost outside dev).

nodes.label: Sentry error monitoring (backend + frontend, currently disabled)
nodes.rationale: Code (sentry_sdk.init in backend, Sentry.init in frontend main.js) is wired but inactive without SENTRY_DSN/VITE_SENTRY_DSN. TODO: sentry.io account not yet created (registration returned 403 at setup time). Frontend requires a rebuild, not just a restart, since VITE_SENTRY_DSN is baked into the bundle at `npm run build` time via a Vite build ARG.
nodes.norm_label: sentry error monitoring (backend + frontend, currently disabled)

nodes.label: DB backup strategy (daily local pg_dump + optional S3)
nodes.rationale: backup-local runs automatically via `docker compose up -d`: daily compressed pg_dump into ./backups with rotation (7 daily / 4 weekly / 6 monthly). Local backups alone don't protect against full VPS/disk loss — recommends rsync/scp offsite or enabling the optional backup-s3 profile.
nodes.norm_label: db backup strategy (daily local pg_dump + optional s3)

nodes.label: Caddy as single TLS-terminating entrypoint (auto Let's Encrypt)
nodes.rationale: Caddy obtains/renews the Let's Encrypt certificate automatically; neither nginx nor backend touch TLS. Works over plain HTTP on bare IP before a domain is configured; setting SITE_ADDRESS to a domain and restarting caddy enables HTTPS with no manual Caddyfile edits.
nodes.norm_label: caddy as single tls-terminating entrypoint (auto let's encrypt)

nodes.label: Mailpit fake SMTP server for local dev email
nodes.rationale: backend/config.py defaults already point at Mailpit; password-reset emails are caught at http://localhost:8025 instead of being sent for real.
nodes.norm_label: mailpit fake smtp server for local dev email

nodes.label: First-run /setup admin creation wizard
nodes.rationale: /api/setup is necessarily public (no admin exists yet to gate it via RBAC), so outside DEBUG it requires SETUP_TOKEN; without a valid token the wizard gets 403, and the app itself refuses to start when DEBUG=false and SETUP_TOKEN is unset. In DEBUG=true no token is required. Once the first admin exists, /api/setup permanently returns 409.

nodes.label: Salon operates entirely in UTC
nodes.rationale: Master work schedules stored/interpreted as UTC; appointment start_time must arrive timezone-aware and is normalized to UTC; reports bucket days by UTC; frontend displays appointment/slot times as the salon's 'wall clock' (timeZone: 'UTC'), not the browser's local timezone.

nodes.label: Brute-force protection: login lockout + password-reset rate limit
nodes.rationale: Temporary login lockout after 5 failures in 15 minutes (login_attempts log); password-reset requests limited to 3/hour.
nodes.norm_label: brute-force protection: login lockout + password-reset rate limit

nodes.label: Backend dev/CI dependencies (requirements-dev.txt: pytest, ruff)
nodes.rationale: Layered on top of requirements.txt via -r; the production image (Dockerfile) installs only requirements.txt, so the test framework never ships in the prod image.

nodes.label: docker-compose.dev.yml service: mailpit
nodes.rationale: Auxiliary dev-only service; backend/frontend/Postgres run natively per README 'Вариант 2: локально'. Exposes SMTP on 1025 and web UI on 8025.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (production stack: Postgres + FastAPI + nginx SPA + Caddy)
nodes.rationale: Without a domain (SITE_ADDRESS unset or ':80'), Caddy serves plain HTTP on port 80 — how the first bare-IP deploy works before DNS is configured.
nodes.norm_label: docker-compose.yml (production stack: postgres + fastapi + nginx spa + caddy)

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backend (FastAPI)
nodes.rationale: Fails fast without SECRET_KEY/SETUP_TOKEN when DEBUG=false (${VAR:?...} interpolation). COOKIE_SECURE only set true once Caddy with a real domain is in front.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: frontend (nginx static SPA)
nodes.rationale: VITE_SENTRY_DSN passed as a build ARG (not environment) because Vite bakes VITE_* vars into the bundle at `npm run build` time; changing the DSN requires a rebuild, not just a restart.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: caddy (TLS terminator, ports 80/443)
nodes.rationale: Healthcheck hits the Caddy admin API (:2019, localhost-only) which is always up regardless of SITE_ADDRESS/domain/HTTPS state — a topology-independent liveness check.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backup-local (daily pg_dump, bind-mounted)
nodes.rationale: Bind-mount (./backups), not a named volume, so backups are visible/retrievable from outside Docker (e.g. rsync/scp offsite).

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backup-s3 (optional S3 backup, profile-gated)
nodes.rationale: Behind the 's3-backup' compose profile so it doesn't crash on every cron run when S3_BACKUP_* env vars are unset by default.
nodes.norm_label: docker-compose.yml service: backup-s3 (optional s3 backup, profile-gated)

nodes.label: Backend healthcheck uses 127.0.0.1, not localhost
nodes.rationale: In containers running as an unprivileged user, the image entrypoint can't always configure the IPv6 listener (no rights to rewrite the root config); 'localhost' resolves to ::1 first and gets connection refused even though the service listens on IPv4. Verified live on this stack. curl/wget aren't in python:3.14-slim, so the healthcheck uses python's own urllib instead.

nodes.label: Design system: coffee-brown + warm gold color palette
nodes.rationale: Adapted from a raw 'Coffee Shop' palette result; the raw #FEF3C7 cream was judged too saturated as a full-page background at dashboard scale, so it's reserved for accent surfaces only, with a lighter #FBF8F3 as the default page canvas.
nodes.norm_label: design system: coffee-brown + warm gold color palette

nodes.label: Design system: typography (Playfair Display headings + Inter body)
nodes.rationale: The raw ui-ux-pro-max tool output (Fira Code/Fira Sans, Noto Serif/Sans JP) was manually rejected as wrong mood and unnecessary Japanese font coverage for a Russian-language app; Playfair Display and Inter both have full Cyrillic sets.
nodes.norm_label: design system: typography (playfair display headings + inter body)

nodes.label: Design system: 3 layout patterns (public/marketing, client app, dashboard)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard pages (Master Dashboard, Admin Panel) use sidebar+main-content per reference screenshots; client task flows (booking, appointments, reviews) deliberately avoid a persistent sidebar as overkill for occasional-use single-task flows.
nodes.norm_label: design system: 3 layout patterns (public/marketing, client app, dashboard)

nodes.label: Design system: component specs (buttons, cards, inputs, status pills, toasts, skeletons, z-index scale)
nodes.rationale: Toasts auto-dismiss after 4s to satisfy the graded spec's '≤5s auto-dismiss' requirement; cards avoid scale-transform hovers to prevent layout shift.
nodes.norm_label: design system: component specs (buttons, cards, inputs, status pills, toasts, skeletons, z-index scale)

nodes.label: Design system: anti-patterns list
nodes.rationale: Explicitly forbids emoji icons, forcing the raw tool's oversized-type 'Exaggerated Minimalism' landing pattern onto dashboard pages, a persistent sidebar on public/booking flows, full-page pure-cream backgrounds, scale-transform card hovers, submit-only validation, and non-auto-dismissing toasts.

nodes.label: Yandex.Metrika analytics counter (metrika.js + noscript pixel)
nodes.rationale: Counter script factored out into /metrika.js; noscript pixel fallback included for JS-disabled clients.

nodes.label: index.html preloaded fonts: Golos Text + JetBrains Mono
nodes.norm_label: index.html preloaded fonts: golos text + jetbrains mono

nodes.label: Static default <title>/description/favicon overridden by applySeo() at runtime
nodes.rationale: Static values serve the very first render / JS-less crawlers; real site-settings values (Admin → SEO) are applied on top via src/theme/seo.js. The favicon link keeps id="site-favicon" to match what applySeo() queries, avoiding a duplicate <link rel="icon">.
nodes.norm_label: static default <title>/description/favicon overridden by applyseo() at runtime
